slice: RPP-5mt consumed MLINE append source counts 174 through 254
scope: Qualifies the authored AC1027 consumed-style one-element append profile for each source count 174 through 254, producing target counts 175 through 255. This extends existing source-count evidence without promoting general MLINE support or native/document semantic claims.

implementation.change: Decode the immutable captured physical group span directly. A counting-stream pass measures exact serialized size; before allocating output, the adapter charges two wire-size allowances, the typed parsed MLINE estimate, and fixed writer/decoder working storage against the existing 64 MiB budget. A fixed-size stream buffer writes the second deterministic pass into one pre-sized string. The source proof no longer clones DRW_RawDxfObject groups or rawValues.
implementation.limit: The 64 MiB conservative named-resource budget is unchanged. The second pass checks the exact expected byte count and fails closed on size or writer mismatch.
implementation.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changed. ASCII/binary and source/output cross-encoding routes remain supported by the selected profile.
implementation.supersedes: RPP-5ms's source-count 174 to 175 refusal measured the former duplicate raw-carrier charge. This receipt supersedes that refusal for current code only; the earlier receipt remains historical evidence.

contract.positiveAdmission: For each source count 174..254 inclusive, generate one AC1027 MLINESTYLE using the existing ordered offset/ACI/alternating ByLayer-Continuous recipe, append one tuple, preserve flags 2 and unchanged angles, and use two source-bound open, uncut and unfilled MLINE consumers.
contract.geometryAndOutput: Verify source and target group-41 minima, target group-71/group-73 counts, ordered style tuples, group-340 style identity, and consumer group-74/group-41/group-75 arrays. Fresh ASCII/binary readback verifies the style tuple and consumer data in model space and a named block.
encodingMatrix: ASCII source to ASCII AC1027 output
ASCII source to binary AC1027 output
binary source to ASCII AC1027 output
binary source to binary AC1027 output
contract.failureAndRetry: Each count has unsupported-flags and late-live-consumer-mutation refusal controls in ASCII and binary output, sentinel destination and caller-state preservation, and corrected-state retry on the same adapter.
contract.boundary: Source count 254 to target count 255 is a successful consumed-style append in this exact profile. It does not qualify the separate 254 to 255 style-retarget operation, which remains refused by its existing aggregate retained-byte admission.

focusedTests.summary: All source counts 129..254 passed, including exact output/readback, unsupported-flags refusal/retry, late-mutation refusal/retry, and all source/output encoding combinations. The 174..253 CTest took 53.62 seconds; the combined three-test CTest completed successfully.

lowCountRegression.summary: The existing source-count-two append range and selected source counts 13, 16, 32, 64 and 128 passed with the direct physical-group path.

asan.summary: Both counts passed all encoding, output/readback, rollback, and retry controls with no AddressSanitizer diagnostics.

sourceBindings.fixturePolicy: All DXF inputs and outputs are generated at runtime from the authored source recipe and removed on success. No testing DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.

limits: The result is limited to the selected generated AC1027 tuple, geometry, consumer and adapter profile.

No other append cardinality, changed flags, angle/offset combinations, carrier, version, producer, complete-document closure, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/FreeCAD native meaning, or 3D semantics follow from this slice.
The separate maximum-count retarget refusal is unchanged.
next: Select and bind one distinct current P2 geometry/schema witness before editing. Prefer a local count-71 edit, additional angle/offset profile, non-two-source append/removal batch, or remaining MLEADERSTYLE field with a focused selector and exact expected output. Keep the maximum-count retarget refusal fail-closed unless a separately bounded representation and witness justify a change.
